_meta.by: harness builder (Claude Code session), on the user's instruction to use provisional values
_meta.rule: Any round that reads a provisional_unratified value is classed learning and never counts toward K9 or K13. Rob ratifies by changing status to 'ratified' (and the value if he wishes) in a dated commit.
_meta.not_set: The T1/T2 values of §33.2 (K1 bounds, promotion-gate margin, ECE ceiling, shadow_min_items, retrain cadence, wiring k and bottom slice, bimodality thresholds, daily flag budget, K6 X, K7 share, per-job recall floor) are deliberately NOT set: the decision-model and data-product tracks are not built here. The loader refuses them if anything reads them.

TURNOVER_FLOOR_USD.basis: §33.1 carried; re-ratify owed now that it floors stock instruments

POSITION_SHARE_FLOOR.basis: §33.1, retired as a veto, report only

TIDE_RATIO_MIN.basis: §33.1, retired as a veto, report only

SURVIVING_MAGNITUDE_MIN.basis: §33.1, retired as a veto, report only

HOP_DISCOUNT.basis: v15 harness/config.py HOP_DISCOUNT, carried as ratified per §33.1 (v15 record imported 2026-09-29)

DEFAULT_HOP_DISCOUNT.basis: v15 value 0.5 confirmed from harness/config.py; still 'to ratify' (§33.1, P0): it was a silent default in v15

TRANSFORM_SEED_STATUS.value: v15 TRANSFORM_SEED (28 entries) carried; builder entries for relations or kinds v15 lacks kept as provisional

ATTENUATION_RULE.basis: stated as a rule, not a depth number, as §33.2 requires

value.declared_by: operator at lock, from the registry; a new tide may be added with a label and a proxy

value.horizon: ACK window in sessions, capped at 63

BOOTSTRAP_DRAWS.basis: builder proposal; seed fixed at 16 for determinism

X8.basis: builder proposal; K8 cannot run in this build (no v15 record)

X10.basis: builder proposal; K10 cannot run in this build (no v15 record)

SYNTH_EPS.basis: relative residual norm of the span projection; builder proposal

TIDE_SHOCK.basis: in units of the tide proxy's horizon standard deviation; builder proposal

ADOPT_MOVE.basis: in units of the story proxy's horizon standard deviation; builder proposal

UNKNOWN_WIDEN.basis: band half-width multiplied by (1 + UNKNOWN_WIDEN) per unknown term; builder proposal

HEDGE_EPS.basis: spec form |w.L_k| <= HEDGE_EPS * sum (w+ + w-) P_i with L_k in currency per one-sd daily story move; 0.002 means story exposure at most 0.2% of gross notional per sd, against ~2% for an unhedged stock; builder proposal

LIQ_CAP.basis: fraction of average daily volume (units) per instrument; builder proposal

BAND_WIDTH_MAX.basis: band half-width over |centre|, degree > 1 only; builder proposal

STRESS_QUANTILE.basis: quantile of adverse horizon move; the stop sits there; builder proposal

STOP_RULE.value: stop at the STRESS_QUANTILE adverse move from entry, checked at each close; a gap through it is a leak

SPREAD_FALLBACK.basis: full quoted spread as a fraction of price when no quote exists; builder proposal

SLIPPAGE_COEF.basis: slippage fraction = coef x qty / ADV; builder proposal

value.vol: realised vol of the underlying over LOADING_SESSIONS before T_seg

OPTION_PRICING_MODEL.basis: for modelled entries only; builder proposal

value.narrowing: zero where no distribution is quoted
value.timing: zero where no option or contract is held
value.leaks: sum over hedged stories and the tide of w.L x realised proxy move, plus pianos and stop gaps

ALT_LATENCY.basis: hours after processing (s2), days after record date (portwatch, weekly publication), hours after sample/origin/acquisition (ioda, usgs, firms). Sets knowable_from for alternative data; conservative by design; builder proposal

OPERATOR_CUTOFF_DEFAULT_RULE.value: unknown training cutoff means public release date (§9); the operator states its cutoff and basis in the manifest

HOP_DISCOUNT_BUILDER.basis: builder's hop discounts for relations v15 never had (customer, competitor, substitute, lender, insurer, grid_neighbour, regulator, counterparty)

CENSUS_CONCENTRATION_PCT.basis: K7 find threshold: the candidate is at least this percent of the instrument's revenue, earnings, capacity or collateral; reuses the inert-stake ceiling (0.25). K7_SHARE itself is deliberately absent: Rob sets it before the census starts

PERSON_INGEST.basis: a switch, not a number. Persons are in the schema and templates; the tool refuses to store one until a legal review and an erasable person store exist (v17 §3.5). Read fail-closed: a missing value is off

ENTITY_MATERIALISE_MAX.basis: non-document entities expanded per round (V2); the effect frontier is 120

COMPOSITE_DEPTH_MAX.basis: a chain inside a market is two levels; a third is a classification (V3)

X14.basis: K14: share of readable qualifying rounds that must show an open-entity find (v17 §9.1)

X15.basis: K15: merge precision; a wrong merge is worse than a missed one

RELATION_UNREVIEWED_MODE.basis: a fixed rule, not a threshold (V2)

BUCKET_MIN_OBS.basis: observations at fan-out > 1 a bucket needs before it has an alpha; below it the bucket is a typed gap and downstream impact is an interval (dilution.py). Set by Rob, 2026-09-29 to 30 (relayed by the requester in the build session)

BUCKET_SHRINK_K.basis: shrinkage of a bucket's alpha toward the pooled fit, in information units (sum of ln(n)^2) (dilution.py). Set by Rob, 2026-09-29 to 30 (relayed by the requester in the build session)

BEND_TOL.basis: a bend is the first depth whose median retention falls by more than this fraction against the depth before (dilution.py). Set by Rob, 2026-09-29 to 30 (relayed by the requester in the build session)

BEND_MIN_NODES.basis: nodes a depth needs before it counts in the bend test (dilution.py). Set by Rob, 2026-09-29 to 30 (relayed by the requester in the build session)

PROFILE_DEPTH_MAX.basis: report-only dilution profile expands to this depth, past SUPPORT_THRESHOLD, bounded by ENTITY_MATERIALISE_MAX; never used for support (dilution.profile_expand). Set by Rob, 2026-09-29 to 30 (relayed by the requester in the build session)

K14_SOURCE_MIN.basis: K14: retrievable lock-time source entities (documents and their kin) a round needs to be readable. Chosen after the census counts were seen (disclosed in lookbacks/K14_prereg.md). Set by Rob, 2026-09-30 (relayed by the requester)
